capacity.max_rehydration_chars_note: Hard cap on injected context block. Items are dropped in reverse priority order when exceeded.
capacity.emergency_override_note: Used only when active commitments with < 2h deadlines would otherwise be truncated. Requires explicit flag.
capacity.warn_at_note: Log a warning in persistence-log.json when rehydration block exceeds this threshold

priority_order_rationale.commitments: Customer-facing promises with deadlines — missing these causes SLA breach and reputational harm
priority_order_rationale.open_decisions: Pending approvals and gates — re-discovering these wastes significant time
priority_order_rationale.active_task: The primary work stream — required for immediate resumption without re-briefing
priority_order_rationale.constraints: Discovered system limits and policy rules — prevents re-hitting known blockers
priority_order_rationale.context_notes: Observational notes and background color — helpful but lowest impact if dropped

staleness.staleness_warn_hours_note: State older than this threshold is marked potentially_stale — include inline warning in rehydration block
staleness.staleness_critical_hours_note: State older than 7 days is marked stale — reduce confidence, flag all values as unverified
staleness.auto_expire_note: Sessions older than 30 days are pruned from history and not loaded during rehydration

session_history.max_sessions_to_load_note: Only the most recent N sessions are included in rehydration context to bound total size

security.never_persist_note: These fields must be actively scrubbed from state before writing session-state.json. Any match on field name OR value pattern triggers scrub.

pii_handling.customer_names: allowed — needed for callback and commitment tracking
pii_handling.customer_phone_numbers: redact — store case_id instead; retrieve phone from CRM at runtime
pii_handling.customer_addresses: redact — not needed for session continuity
pii_handling.account_ids: allowed — opaque identifiers safe to persist
pii_handling.case_ids: allowed — opaque identifiers safe to persist

cs_specific_priority_boost.commitments_within_24h: promote to top of commitments list regardless of age
cs_specific_priority_boost.pending_callbacks_within_4h: flag as urgent in rehydration block header

formatting.staleness_warn_prefix: WARNING: State is {age}h old — verify before acting
formatting.staleness_critical_prefix: STALE STATE ({age}h old) — treat all cached values as unverified
formatting.truncation_notice: [{n} lower-priority item(s) truncated to stay within {cap}-char rehydration cap]
